description: This PHP source file contains the code for a web interface that manages SIP Basic Setup for a Voice over IP (VoIP) service provider. It includes PHP functions to fetch SIP configuration data, HTML form elements for user input, and JavaScript for dynamic form handling and AJAX communication with backend PHP scripts to apply or start/stop SIP client configurations.

methods.name: Dm_data_get
methods.description: Function that retrieves current SIP configuration data from the device using specific getStr() calls and returns it as an associative array.
